description: Upload an audience to an ad platform (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Microsoft, Reddit, TikTok, X). Accepts inline hashed identifiers (hashed_emails, hashed_phones), raw mobile_ids (IDFA/GAID), company_domains, a public csv_url, or *_artifact_id references staged via stage_audience_artifact. Costs 10 credits on success.

account_id.description: Platform ad account id. Optional — defaults to the user's primary account on that platform.

audience_name.description: Name for the audience as it should appear in the platform's UI.

company_domains.description: Comma-separated company domains for B2B account targeting (Google + LinkedIn).

csv_url.description: Public CSV URL with audience identifiers. Alternative to inline params / artifact ids.

customer_file_source.description: Meta only: USER_PROVIDED_ONLY (default), PARTNER_PROVIDED_ONLY, or BOTH_USER_AND_PARTNER_PROVIDED.

hashed_emails.description: Comma-separated SHA-256 hashed emails (lowercase hex). For small batches; use hashed_emails_artifact_id for >500.

hashed_emails_artifact_id.description: Artifact id from stage_audience_artifact for SHA-256 hashed emails.

hashed_phones.description: Comma-separated SHA-256 hashed phones (E.164 format pre-hash). For small batches.

hashed_phones_artifact_id.description: Artifact id from stage_audience_artifact for SHA-256 hashed phones. Meta + most platforms; not supported by Google's customer match script today.

i_have_consent.description: Confirm the customer has lawful basis (GDPR Art. 6) and required consent under CCPA / Meta Custom Audience Terms / Google Customer Match Policy for every identifier in this audience. Soft-launch: omitting this flag logs a warning until 2026-05-21, after which the upload is rejected with PII_CONSENT_REQUIRED. Pass true only if your customer has obtained the required consents.

mobile_ids.description: Comma-separated raw mobile advertising IDs (IDFA / GAID, uppercase UUID). Meta and TikTok only. NOT hashed.

mobile_ids_artifact_id.description: Artifact id for raw mobile ids. Meta only.

name: sync_audience
